context7._comment: Live, version-correct library docs (Upstash context7). Tools: resolve-library-id, get-library-docs. Used by researcher/builder/reviewer to avoid stale-knowledge bias. See FEAT-016 + docs/routing-table.md.

astramem._comment: AstraMemory MCP. Tools: agent_profile, recall_memory, search_memory, remember, submit_feedback. Powers the skills/universal/using-memory skill so every agent can actively recall its track record + task memory and feed back what helped. Set MEMORY_API_URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7777) + MEMORY_BEARER; absent env = fail-silent (tools just won't resolve). The SubagentStart profile hook still loads each agent's track record deterministically at dispatch regardless.
